classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a verbatim transcript of a National Council debate and was created at the time of the event by the Council's recording service.
classification.resume: This document is a parliamentary record from the Swiss National Council (Nationalrat) capturing the proceedings of a debate on measures for civil peace promotion and human rights strengthening, dated 19 December 2003. It contains the legislative text of a federal law in both German and French. The record is an audio recording of the debate.
